question: Which of the following Acts created a unified administration system for India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Regulating Act of 1773**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Regulating Act of 1773** was the first step toward centralizing the administration of British India.
 
• It created a unified system by:
 
 
• Establishing the post of the **Governor-General of Bengal** (Warren Hastings was the first Governor-General).
 
• Giving the Governor-General's council authority over the Presidencies of Bombay and Madras in matters of governance, creating a centralized administration.
 
• **Introducing a Supreme Court **at Calcutta to administer justice.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**
